description: This file defines the interface for a factory class that creates internal server implementations of IWebAudioPlayer for the Rialto media server. It includes method declarations for creating WebAudioPlayer instances with specific configurations and dependencies.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating internal server WebAudioPlayer instances for the Rialto media server.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a WebAudioPlayer instance for internal server use with specified client, MIME type, priority, configuration, shared memory buffer, and handle.
